success_def: success = cube centre over a deck, within 2 cm of its resting height and still for 12 consecutive steps; release is not checked (the hands may still be on it), nor how it got there (lift or tip; see cube_tilted / tipped_over_deck)
note: CubeToShelfStand3 (side deck): a different, easier task than CubeToShelf and CubeToShelfStand2; never compared with either
